[IARC.3.2.2] The runtime spec commitment to "single-writer"
([RARC.6]) is
satisfied structurally: the pump function is the
only writer, and the integrator runs it from one
context at a time. The engine does not enforce this
with locks; the integrator is responsible for not
calling pump concurrently from multiple contexts on
the same engine. Documented, not policed — keeps
the library thread-free.
